This TU licenses all 62, ROM ordinals 0..61, as one .text claim. Below it is src/minigames/d_s_mg_card.cpp (ends 0x020dbe40); above it is dScMgCoin_c_classInit in src/d_s_mg_coin.cpp (0x020de940..0x020de988), which tu_map does not put in this unit and which stays its own file.

WIDENED from the earlier 33-function claim 0x020dbf7c..0x020dd0e0. The two holes that bounded it, _ZN11dScMgCoin_c8Bag_DrawEv and _ZN11dScMgCoin_c19Coin_StateWaitTouchEi, both byte-matched in their own shards since that claim was written; with them the run is one piece. 29 shards were folded: D1, D0 and _ZN11dScMgCoin_c8Bag_DrawEv below, and the 26 functions from _ZN11dScMgCoin_c19Coin_StateWaitTouchEi to InitResources above, including the four own overrides OnYoshiTryEat, Render, Behavior and InitResources.

DESTRUCTOR ORDER. The cartridge has D1 at 0x020dbe40 below D0 at 0x020dbe64 and no D2 home. One out-of-line ~dScMgCoin_c() under #pragma defer_codegen off emits D1 then D0 in that order; the D2 mwccarm also emits is a compiler_only_output deadstrip row.

KEY FUNCTION. The out-of-line destructor is the class's first declared virtual, so this TU now emits _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS11dScMgCoin_c and the ancestor RTTI chain (fBase_c, dBase_c, dScene_c, dScMgBase_c). Each is a deadstrip-data row with its canonical symbols.txt home; ov006 .data stays ROM-owned, so the TU stays text-only.
SOURCE ORDER IS ROM-ASCENDING, lowest address first, under #pragma defer_codegen off; tubuild verify reports all 62 in ROM-ascending emission order.

notes: Generated by tools/tubuild.py create for the first 33 functions, then widened by hand to the whole unit. See the file's own header comment.

Declaration conflicts between the folded shards are resolved the same way throughout: one extern "C" declaration per symbol at file scope, and a cast at the call where a shard had spelled the parameter differently. Local struct tags (C, E, Entry, Obj, Pair, PMF, Self, Work) are renamed per function rather than merged, because merging changes mwccarm pointer-to-member and struct-copy codegen; each function keeps the shape its shard matched under.

_ZN11dScMgCoin_c17Block_StateWanderEi and _ZN11dScMgCoin_c11SpawnBlocksEv called vtable slot 35 through a 36-slot stand-in struct. They now call dScMgBase_c::IsAltVariant (slot 35) on dScMgCoin_c; the bytes are unchanged.

_ZN11dScMgCoin_c13Popup_DrawAllEv now takes the dScMgCoin_c * that Render passes in r0; it does not read it. _ZN11dScMgCoin_c8Bag_DrawEv keeps its shard's #pragma opt_propagation off inside a push/pop bracket.

Static-initializer fold: __sinit_ov006_0213014c retired. The five pointer-to-member state tables are file-scope definitions initialised from the extern pointer-to-member constants pmf_dScMgCoin_c_Bag_StateIdle..0213bf04, so mwcc emits the initializer itself. The constants stay outside this TU's claim and are reached by extern, as in the ov004 unit020b2c84 fold. The tables are defined in the order the initializer fills them (phases, blocks, coins, caption, moneybag). mwcc lays each object in its own .bss section and orders them by size, which puts them at 0x021417b0, 0x021417c8, 0x021417e8, 0x02141810 and 0x02141840 as in retail. The run's .bss (0x021417b0..0x02141870) starts where d_s_mg_card's ends and ends where dScMgCup_c's starts. Its .init and .ctor slots sit between those two TUs' slots as well.
